findings.quoted_text: Contractor shall provide to Company, and hereby assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.
Contractor shall provide to Company, and hereby assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.
findings.explanation: This clause uses present assignment wording ("hereby assigns"), which means ownership of your work transfers immediately upon creation or termination rather than waiting for full payment.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of final payment, Contractor shall provide to Company, and hereby assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am writing to propose a minor adjustment to the agreement before we proceed. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning works in progress, the current wording transfers ownership immediately rather than upon full payment. I propose modifying this so that the assignment takes effect upon receipt of final payment. Thank you for your time and understanding.
